description: Take a tag off a job. The tag itself stays on the account and stays on every other job carrying it. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. This tool sends nothing to the customer itself; Housecall Pro's own automations are outside this server's control. Housecall Pro does not record tag changes in the customer activity log, so tagging cannot be confirmed silent by inspection.

tag_id.description: Tag id (tag_...) from hcp_list_tags. A tag name is accepted only if it matches one exactly.

name: hcp_remove_job_tag
